assumptions: The single visible occurrence of the literal string 'Vertical Framed Poster' on the storefront product page (inside Shopify's native <variant-selects> component) is the storefront rendering of teeinblue's 'campaign_products[0].product.title/label' field — i.e. the same field portal-explorer's TASK-5 typed as the Dynamic Translation 'Default' source text. This mapping is inferred from field-name/value match (both are exactly 'Vertical Framed Poster' for this campaign's single product base) and from the campaign JSON API response structure, not from an explicit portal/API label confirming this is 'the' field the Dynamic Translations UI targets. api-explorer should confirm this mapping from backend code/schema.
unknowns: Whether Dynamic Translation propagation to storefront requires an unobserved separate action (e.g. a 'sync to Shopify' / republish step, or is scoped to multi-product-base campaigns / a different display surface such as an artwork navigation dropdown or Option Title) not triggered in this run — this run only exercised the single-product, product_display_type='radio' campaign 2595, which has no distinct personalization 'Option Title' field of its own (per portal-explorer's OBS-007/assumptions). Could not determine whether Dynamic Translations for 'Option Title in the personalization form' propagate correctly, since campaign 2595 has no such field to test.

Whether other campaigns/product-bases (with genuine free-text Option Titles) would show different Dynamic Translation propagation behavior — not tested; only campaign 2595 was in scope per bootstrap-request.

Exact server-side rendering mechanism that injects the Product Page Content translation into the initial HTML document (app embed / theme app extension calling teeinblue backend at Shopify page-render time) — inferred from evidence (marker string present in the raw document response, absent from every XHR/fetch/script response captured) but the literal request/response of that server-to-server call is not visible to a storefront-side browser trace; api-explorer/code-config-explorer should confirm from backend routing.

Whether a longer wait or a genuinely different browsing session (e.g. real merchant CDN cache, not this run's fresh Playwright contexts) would ever surface the Dynamic Translation for the product base name — only ~10s of observation per load was tested, and the campaign API response was re-checked directly (not just DOM) confirming no vi data at the API layer either, which makes a 'just needs more time' explanation unlikely but not impossible.

Only Product Page Content was actually observed to propagate in this run; Dynamic Translations (product base name) did not appear anywhere on the storefront product page for campaign 2595, at either the HTML/DOM layer or the underlying teeinblue campaign API response layer.

observations.action: Navigate to https://linh-explorer.myshopify.com/ (fresh session) and pass the Shopify storefront password gate.
observations.observed_result: Redirected to /password on first request (confirms store is password-protected, consistent with prior run CTX-20260915-01); after submitting the store password, redirected back to / with title 'linh-explorer'. Store identity confirmed via window.Shopify.shop='linh-explorer.myshopify.com'.
observations.state_after: storefront_digest session cookie set (value not recorded — session cookie, credential-shaped, redacted from all written evidence)

observations.action: Inventory the header language switcher: locate it, list its options, and identify its implementation mechanism.
observations.observed_result: Confirmed a 'Language' localization-form present in 4 places in the DOM: desktop header (#HeaderLanguageForm), mobile header (#HeaderLanguageMobileForm), plus matching #HeaderCountryForm / #HeaderCountryMobileForm for Country/region, and duplicate Language/Country forms in the footer (#FooterLanguageForm, #FooterCountryForm) — all instances of Shopify's own Dawn-theme <localization-form> Liquid/JS component (component-localization-form.css, localization-form.js loaded from the theme's own /cdn/shop/t/ assets), NOT a teeinblue-authored component. Desktop header switcher shows current selection as a text button ('English' before switch); clicking it opens a disclosure list (#HeaderLanguageList) with exactly 2 options: 'English' (data-value='en', aria-current='true' initially) and 'Tiếng việt' (data-value='vi') — matches portal-explorer's shop-locales observation (en/vi, en=primary) exactly, both in count and in locale codes.
observations.state_after: locale list inventoried, no change yet

observations.action: Click the 'Tiếng việt' option in the header language switcher.
observations.observed_result: Submits a multipart POST to https://linh-explorer.myshopify.com/localization with form_type=localization, _method=put, return_to=/, locale_code=vi. Server responds 302; browser ends up at https://linh-explorer.myshopify.com/vi (locale now embedded as a URL PATH PREFIX, not a query param or client-only cookie toggle). document.documentElement.lang becomes 'vi'. The switcher button's own displayed label updates to 'Tiếng việt' (theme's own localized name for Vietnamese — note the capitalization differs from portal's UI label 'Vietnamese', which is expected since these are two independent pieces of UI text). Portal's own combobox uses the identical locale_code values (en/vi) sourced from the same Shopify shop-locales data — CONFIRMED: the storefront header switcher IS the Shopify Markets/locale mechanism itself (native theme component driven by locale_code posted to Shopify's own /localization endpoint), not an independent teeinblue-built language toggle. This directly answers bootstrap-request note (b)/(e): the language is genuinely sourced from Shopify's market/locale system, and the header switcher is just Shopify Dawn's stock UI for changing it.
observations.act_id: N/A (storefront-only state change, not a data mutation — no cleanup needed, reverting the switcher is itself just another view-state change)

observations.action: Locate campaign 2595's storefront product page (product base 'Vertical Framed Poster') via the storefront's own predictive search (/search/suggest.json?q=...), since no direct URL was given, then navigate to it under both en and vi locale.
observations.observed_result: Search for 'Vertical Framed Poster' and for 'QA Explore Campaign PB 01' both resolve to the same product: handle=qa-explore-campaign-pb-01, title='QA Explore Campaign PB 01' (the CAMPAIGN name is the storefront product title, not the product-base name). Confirmed via the page's own teeinblue API call that this maps to campaign_id 2595 / product_id 8138398629987 / product base id 3181 with title/label 'Vertical Framed Poster' — matching the bootstrap-request's TASK-5 target exactly. Page loads at /products/qa-explore-campaign-pb-01 (en) and /vi/products/qa-explore-campaign-pb-01 (vi) — locale is carried purely via the URL path prefix, consistent with SF-OBS-003.
observations.state_after: on campaign 2595 product page, en and vi variants both loaded in separate sessions for comparison

observations.action: With locale=vi active, load the campaign 2595 product page and inspect the teeinblue personalization widget's form header label (element .tee-form-header__title) — the exact field/value portal-explorer edited in ACT-01-05-003 (form_header_title, EN default 'personalize', VI test value 'Cá nhân hóa QA-TEST-CTX20260921-02').
observations.observed_result: CONFIRMED PROPAGATED. On https://linh-explorer.myshopify.com/products/qa-explore-campaign-pb-01 (en) the widget shows 'PERSONALIZE' (rendered upper-case by CSS text-transform; underlying value is the EN default 'personalize'). On https://linh-explorer.myshopify.com/vi/products/qa-explore-campaign-pb-01 (vi) the SAME element shows 'CÁ NHÂN HÓA QA-TEST-CTX20260921-02' (rendered upper-case; underlying value is exactly the string saved in portal ACT-01-05-003, 'Cá nhân hóa QA-TEST-CTX20260921-02'). The translated text is present in the very first HTML document response for the /vi/products/... request itself (confirmed by inspecting the raw 'document' resourceType response body directly, not just the rendered DOM) — it is NOT delivered via any separate client-side XHR/fetch call; the teeinblue campaign-config API call (GET /api/merchant/campaigns/8138398629987.json) returns only the English default value in both en and vi page loads (also tested with explicit Accept-Language: vi/vi-VN headers — no effect). This means the personalization form's translated label is applied SERVER-SIDE at page-render time (the app embed block resolving the correct locale before the browser ever receives HTML), not client-side.
observations.state_before: portal ACT-01-05-003 already saved (Vietnamese form_header_title override live in portal DB per portal-evidence.json)
observations.state_after: storefront vi-locale page renders the translated label

evidence_refs.note: negative evidence — ruled out the SDK JS bundles as the data source

observations.action: With locale=vi active, search the full product page (DOM text walk, not just visible viewport) for the Dynamic Translation source text 'Vertical Framed Poster' and its saved Vietnamese translation 'Áp phích khung dọc QA-TEST-CTX20260921-02' (portal ACT-05-01-005, record id=69).
observations.observed_result: NOT PROPAGATED (as observed). The string 'Vertical Framed Poster' still appears in English on the vi-locale product page; 'Áp phích khung dọc QA-TEST-CTX20260921-02' does not appear anywhere on the page. The ONLY occurrence of 'Vertical Framed Poster' on the whole page is inside Shopify's own native <variant-selects> theme component ('Available Product' selector, data-product-title attribute and the selected option's value) — this is Shopify's synced product/variant data, rendered entirely by the Dawn theme's own Liquid/JS, not by the teeinblue app-embed widget. The teeinblue campaign-config API response itself (same call as SF-OBS-005's evidence) still contains campaign_products[0].product.title/label = 'Vertical Framed Poster' (English) in BOTH en and vi page loads — confirming the Dynamic Translation record is not merged into this API response either, so it isn't simply a rendering/DOM-selector issue on teeinblue's side; the translated value never appears to leave the portal's database in this flow. No other UI location for an 'Option Title'-style field was found on this campaign to cross-check (campaign 2595 uses product_display_type='radio' with a single product base and no free-text personalization Option Title — see unknowns).
observations.state_before: portal ACT-05-01-005 already saved (record id=69, 'Vertical Framed Poster' -> 'Áp phích khung dọc QA-TEST-CTX20260921-02', locale=vi)
observations.state_after: storefront vi-locale page still shows the English default; no visible change from the Dynamic Translation entry

observations.action: Capture the full set of network requests made by the storefront product page to teeinblue-owned domains (staging-api.teeinblue.com, staging-sdk.teeinblue.com, cdn.teeinblue.com, cdn.ownego.com) on both en and vi locale loads, for handoff to api-explorer (TASK-9).
observations.observed_result: Exactly 2 calls to staging-api.teeinblue.com per page load: GET /api/merchant/campaigns/{campaign_product_id}.json?shop=linh-explorer.myshopify.com&v={cache-bust} (the widget's config source — English-only, no locale variance observed) and GET /api/merchant/shopify/thumbmark. Two calls to staging-sdk.teeinblue.com: /shopify/app-v2.js?token=...&shop=... and /async.js?platform=shopify&v=2&token=...&shop=... (SDK bootstrap scripts; token query param redacted in saved evidence). No dedicated 'get translations for locale X' endpoint was observed anywhere on the storefront in ~340 captured requests per page load — this contradicts the initial expectation of a locale-parameterized storefront translation-fetch call, and is an important negative finding for api-explorer.
